settings.heading: Will the compressed bag fit in my carry-on?

settings.text: Yes — each bag measures 18.5″ × 11.8″ × 5.9″ and compresses down to roughly 3″ thick, sized for standard carry-ons and backpacks. Your suitcase still needs to meet your airline's size rules — Voltairs just makes sure everything fits inside it.

No. The 30W pump is USB-C rechargeable, has a long-lasting battery, and doubles as an LED light. It deflates a full bag in seconds — and with the included nozzles it inflates air mattresses and pool floats too.

settings.heading: Will my clothes come out wrinkled?

settings.text: Compression presses clothes flat rather than crumpling them, so jeans, knits, and casual wear come out fine. Fold delicate shirts on top of the stack and give them a quick shake-out when you arrive.

settings.heading: How much actually fits in one bag?

settings.text: Up to 22 lb of clothing per bag — roughly 8–10 days of outfits once compressed to about 40% of their original size. The kit includes two bags.
